title: 3 NEW MSFS Aircraft Tested: Got Friends Taylorcraft, Pioneer 400 & E-767 AWACS!
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down the latest marketplace drop featuring three distinct airframes serving up a stark divide in flight styles—ranging from handcrafted vintage taildraggers to modern Italian composite tourers and heavy military radar surveillance.

To help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget, we inspect each arrival in detail:

• Got Friends Taylorcraft BC-12D: A handcrafted vintage classic built with real-world pilot feedback, Wwise sound recordings, and authentic wear-and-tear. Includes 4 distinct configurations: standard 17-inch vintage wheels, 26-inch bush/tundra tires, Federal 1500 skis, and EDO 1320 floats, plus support for third-party GTN 650 avionics.
• Alpi Aviation Pioneer 400 (OBY No. 1): A versatile four-seat Italian touring aircraft featuring a turbocharged engine, retractable landing gear, top-hinged canopy doors, and a modern dual G3X touch glass cockpit with Little Navmap, SimBrief, and YourControls compatibility.
• Captain Sim Boeing E-767 AWACS: A massive military airborne surveillance platform featuring an animated rotodome, high-resolution 8K textures, detailed exterior animations (pitot plugs, chocks, emergency doors), and an interior cabin—though built primarily around exterior visual fidelity rather than study-level systems.

Whether you're after rugged backcountry bush trips, smooth cross-country IFR touring, or massive military patrols, we evaluate each package to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your virtual hangar.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below! Which of these aircraft are you adding to your hangar?
